races.paceDynamic: Joulany, Alfaraz, and My Love Is King will go forward from the gates, with at least two committing to genuine pace-setting through the first half-mile. This creates a strong early gallop that will stretch the field and test stamina reserves over the final three furlongs. The prominent brigade of Maltese Cross, Shabab Al Ahli, Sahara King and Barrister will create congestion in behind, leading to traffic problems turning for home. This pace scenario clearly favours horses with tactical speed who can position prominently without getting trapped, while the strong gallop will find out any with stamina limitations.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Strong Pace Collapses
scenarios.trigger: If the three front-runners go too hard early and crack inside the final furlong
scenarios.body: The genuine pace collapse allows patient types to sweep through late, while prominent racers who saved energy can capitalize. Those with proven stamina at this trip will thrive as others empty out.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Tactical Speed Dominates
scenarios.trigger: If the pace is strong but sustainable, creating ideal conditions for prominent racers
scenarios.body: Horses positioned in the first four can track the pace without getting trapped in traffic, then quicken when it matters. The strong gallop finds out pure hold-up types who need the race to fall apart.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Front Runner Survives
scenarios.trigger: If one of the pace-setters gets an easy lead and the others drop back early
scenarios.body: The winner gets soft sectionals up front before quickening, while prominent trackers struggle to bridge the gap having followed a false pace. Late finishers can't make up the ground from too far back.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Traffic Carnage Benefits
scenarios.trigger: If the prominent bunch gets badly hampered turning for home with nowhere to go
scenarios.body: Horses drawn wide or held up can sweep around the trouble, while those trapped in the pack lose all chance despite having winning chances. Clean passages become crucial for any realistic victory bid.

watchPoints.text: Joulany and Alfaraz could set suicidal fractions if both commit to leading, creating pace collapse scenario
Maltese Cross and Shabab Al Ahli may get trapped behind the prominent wall turning for home with limited racing room
Much and Easwrith Destiny are unraced wildcards who could upset calculations if significantly better than shown in work
My Love Is King's 151-day absence could blunt his early pace, allowing others to dictate terms more easily
The prominent quartet of rated horses may sacrifice each other's chances through tactical congestion in the straight

races.paceDynamic: Maxident will lead from the start with Lavender Hill Mob and Call My Bluff tracking in prominent positions behind. The pace should be steady rather than frantic over this extended trip, with the single leader not under pressure early. The back markers Classical Allusion, Blazeon Five, Pole Star, Caprelo and Francesco Baracca will settle well off the pace in the rear division. This race shape strongly favours the hold-up horses who can finish with one sustained run, as they'll get the perfect tow into the race from a solid but uncontested gallop.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Hold-Up Horses Dominate
scenarios.trigger: If the pace stays steady and controlled throughout
scenarios.body: Maxident sets an even tempo without pressure, allowing the back markers to time their challenges perfectly in the final 3-4 furlongs. The closers get ideal conditions to unleash finishing kicks against tiring pace-setters.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Prominent Runners Strike
scenarios.trigger: If Lavender Hill Mob or Call My Bluff apply early pressure to Maxident
scenarios.body: The tempo increases sufficiently to blunt some of the hold-up horses' finishing kicks while setting up perfectly for those racing handily. Recent winner Lavender Hill Mob or consistent Call My Bluff can sustain their efforts better than pure closers.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Maxident Wire-To-Wire
scenarios.trigger: If Maxident gets uncontested fractions and finds extra reserves
scenarios.body: The leader maintains a steady rhythm throughout before finding enough in the tank to repel late challengers. His 220-day break could have freshened him up considerably for trainer Philippart De Foy.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Pace Collapses Early
scenarios.trigger: If the early pace becomes crawling with multiple hold-up horses struggling for room
scenarios.body: The race becomes a messy sprint finish where positioning and luck matter more than pure ability. Horses with tactical speed or prominent positions gain crucial advantages in the final furlong.

watchPoints.text: Maxident could steal this if allowed uncontested fractions given his 220-day freshening break
Classical Allusion has Oisin Murphy aboard despite limited experience - Murphy booking suggests hidden improvement
Pole Star's 188-day absence is concerning but his good ground record and William Buick partnership demands respect
Lavender Hill Mob's recent Lingfield win and prominent style could prove hard to peg back if getting first run on the field
Call My Bluff and Caprelo both have headgear changes applied suggesting their connections expect better efforts

races.paceDynamic: Caballo Grande and Tamashal will dispute the early lead in this competitive handicap, with The Resdev Scholar and On The Inlet likely to press them from prominent positions. The pace should be honest but not breakneck with two natural front-runners ensuring no dawdling, creating a solid gallop that will test stamina reserves over this stiff 7f at Newbury. The strong early pace will set up the race perfectly for closers, as the leaders face pressure throughout and may tire in the final furlong. This race shape clearly favours hold-up horses who can produce late kicks, as the pace-setters will have done the hard work up front.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Strong Pace Collapses Leaders
scenarios.trigger: If Caballo Grande and Tamashal go too fast early and burn out
scenarios.body: The honest gallop becomes unsustainable and the front-runners capitulate, allowing the best closers with tactical speed to sweep past them late. Hold-up horses with class like Colori Forever and Astrazar can time their challenges perfectly.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Prominent Tracker Strikes
scenarios.trigger: If The Resdev Scholar or Stellar Sunrise get perfect positioning just behind the leaders
scenarios.body: They avoid the early pace battle but stay close enough to strike when the leaders weaken, benefiting from the strong gallop without doing the donkey work. These prominently-ridden horses can kick clear before the back-markers arrive.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Pace Stays Strong Throughout
scenarios.trigger: If Caballo Grande maintains his stamina and Tamashal keeps finding more
scenarios.body: The leaders prove their staying power over this trip and the honest pace actually plays to their strengths rather than against them. Front-runners with genuine stamina can hold off late challenges when the pace stays solid.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Tactical Battle Goes Slow
scenarios.trigger: If neither leader wants to make the running and they go steady early
scenarios.body: The race becomes a tactical affair with a sprint finish, completely changing the complexion and favouring horses with natural speed over stamina. This would suit the classier performers who can quicken sharply from any position.

watchPoints.text: Caballo Grande and Tamashal must be monitored early to see if they establish sustainable fractions or go too fast
Fort Rock needs to show early sharpness returning from his 163-day absence or he may struggle to get competitive position
The Resdev Scholar could be overbet given recent good form but faces much stronger opposition than recent victories
Colori Forever's draw in stall 15 could prove problematic if the pace collapses and he needs to come from too far back
Astrazar's return to turf after winter break should suit but market support will indicate stable confidence

races.paceDynamic: Montezin is the sole confirmed front runner and should get an uncontested lead at a sustainable pace through the early furlongs. Change Sings, Gweedore, Lakers, and Photosynthesis will track prominently but none are aggressive enough to pressure the leader early. The lack of pace pressure means the race will develop into a sprint from the 2f pole when the prominent runners fan out. This setup strongly favours hold-up horses who can produce their best turn of foot in the final furlong when others are beginning to tire.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Hold-Up Horses Dominate
scenarios.trigger: If Montezin sets uncontested fractions and the pace quickens late
scenarios.body: The patient runners get the perfect setup to unleash finishing kicks while the early leaders and prominent runners struggle to respond to late acceleration. Arctic Thunder, Juan Les Pins, and Wheels Of Fire are ideally positioned to benefit from this tactical scenario.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Prominent Tracker Triumph
scenarios.trigger: If Change Sings or Lakers can position perfectly behind Montezin without getting caught wide
scenarios.body: The prominent runners get first run on the weakening leader while maintaining enough energy to hold off the late closers. Lakers looks best placed with David Egan knowing when to make his move.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Front Runner Steals It
scenarios.trigger: If Montezin's class advantage and light weight allows him to kick clear when challenged
scenarios.body: The leader maintains his advantage despite the long break, using his low weight of 118lbs to full effect. Antony Brittain has timed this return perfectly and Montezin's recent form suggests he retains his ability.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Pace Collapse Upset
scenarios.trigger: If the early pace is genuinely slow and none of the fancied runners can quicken decisively
scenarios.body: The race becomes a messy scramble where an unfancied runner with a turn of foot can sneak through. The form horses fail to separate themselves and value emerges from the pack.

watchPoints.text: Montezin's 144-day layoff could see him tire badly in the final furlong if the break has left him short of peak fitness
Arctic Thunder's 185-day absence makes him a risky proposition despite his hold-up style suiting the likely pace scenario
Watch how aggressively Change Sings and Lakers position themselves behind Montezin as their tactics will shape the race development
Juan Les Pins's recent form over 6f has been excellent and his hold-up style could prove decisive if he gets the right splits
The pace could collapse completely if none of the prominent runners pressure Montezin early, creating an unpredictable finish
